title: Admin ChatBot
text:
## Admin ChatBot
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000099093
The Chatbot is a feature that is available for all Brilliant Directories websites. The chatbot is ⭐infused⭐ with ChatGPT powers + able to assist with general questions, troubleshooting and ideas.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12164647701/original/UUketdmNt_IuD0aY70dQ074IundsVbJ7vw.png?1753162306 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12164647724/original/Dg4T3Vxey1-k8uGrqb9Qo97FOkG8FJ2xqQ.png?1753162350 | alt: ]
With a few guardrails in place and queued to assume help with your BD website…
Primed to help with copywriting
Social media post ideas
ChatGPT 4 Capabilities
Coding Suggestions and More!
Our hope is to provide yet another support channel where BDers can get real-time answers + assistance using AI trained on BD documentation and with the power of ChatGPT 4.
The display for this feature has 3 options:
Show Chatbot In The Admin
show_chatbot_admin
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12164647748/original/s6cjaCVk9U7pIeEDZdJYq9ddjLpzx-_3zQ.png?1753162421 | alt: ]
Hide
